lessons.title: 1. Dot Product & Similarity
lessons.description: Calculate dot product between two numerical feature vectors in Python.
lessons.solution_code:
def dot_product(vec_a: list[float], vec_b: list[float]) -> float:
    return sum(a * b for a, b in zip(vec_a, vec_b))

source.name: Dive into Deep Learning §2.3 Linear Algebra — dot product is 'a sum over the products of the elements at the same position'

learning_objectives: Compute the dot product of two equal-length vectors
Accumulate element-wise products with a generator expression and sum()
